label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Clean Your Email List Regularly
body: Removing inactive subscribers improves your email deliverability and engagement rates, ensuring your messages reach those who want them.
caption:
Hey there, fellow creator! 💌 Ever wonder why some emails don't get opened? A big reason can be a list full of people who aren't interested anymore. Regularly tidying up your email list by removing inactive subscribers means your messages go to folks who actually want to hear from you.
